name: Abadia Retuerta LeDomaine
insider_take: A 12th-century abbey transformed into Spain's most exclusive wine estate retreat, where Michelin-starred dining meets thousand-year-old history in Ribera del Duero's prestigious vineyards.
whats_special: This former Benedictine monastery sits on a 700-hectare estate producing some of Spain's finest wines. The property features original Romanesque architecture, including a stunning cloister, while offering contemporary luxury amenities. Chef Marc Segarra's restaurant Refectorio earned a Michelin star, serving innovative cuisine paired with the estate's exceptional vintages.
pro_tip: Book the "Winemaker for a Day" experience to create your own blend with the estate's head winemaker, then enjoy a private dinner in the historic wine cellar surrounded by centuries-old stone walls.
dont_miss: The sunset wine tasting on the abbey's ancient tower offering panoramic views over the Duero Valley, and a visit to the on-site archaeological site where Roman ruins tell the story of 2,000 years of winemaking tradition on this very land.
pros: Historic 12th-century abbey converted into luxury hotel
Award-winning winery with premium wine tastings
Stunning riverside location in Ribera del Duero wine region
